Chengo ong'a obostarangko u'ina man*na gita see rakiani dongja. Ma'gitcham pagitchamrangni kattarangko deritchu su'ritchurangni aganrikrikbaani. 2. Gisik ra anina songe dongimin ro’ong- rango ba silplengrango kite see donanirang. 3. Gipin a songoni songreba'giparangni an*- tangtangni re'bao nika obostarangko see rakiani- rang. Mongsongbate iarangonikosan chengoni Indian! kattarangko sandie chimonge man*a dipet sulsul ja'mano seaha. 2. INDIA A SONG I . Indiara Asian! salgipengo dong^ipa bak ong'a ; jeko dal'begipa a*brirangni ritingchi, suurini pakma gita, salgro saliramoni salaramona mail 1000 2 na batpile dingtangata. Uarangkon Himalayas ine minga, aro uara mailbri mailbonga chua ; mitamrango maildok ong*nasipila aro salgi nang- gitota gita nikpila. Na a put kolgrik chugipa

pakmako maldona neng'nikbejawachimma ? Ugita pakma king looo ko ge’sani kosako ge'sa gatoa ine chanchichipbo. Aiao ! uarang aramrangna bateba chubatgenchim. 2. Himalaya kattara Sanskrit ku’sikoni ong’kata. Himani orto suuri alayani orto nok ba song ong'a, Uni gimin Himalayani mangsongara suurini song ba nok ong'a. Uarangko indine minga, maina ua chubegipaa'brirangni kosako pangnabajronggija suurirang dongkama. Uno mamung gam*anirang- ko knaja aro apalgipa suurini a'barangna agre mamung gipinko nikani dongja. 3. Indian! salgrochi ia Himalaya a'brirangni nalsao donggipa a-songko Asiani bijatchi ine minga. Uanoba ka-sinbea, bang'bata a- an raka, ro'ongrara, bang'gija mikkarangsan waa aro bang-- gija chibimarangsan dongaia. Ua inditan chua, ua a'songni mitam bakko A'gilsakni Nokking ine minga. Skang^i salrango jahatrang dongja. Chonchongipa ringrangsan dongaia aro uaranga dal'gipa balwa ta'rakgipa sagalko chobatna man'jachim. Jensalo salgroni songona bate uano mairongpile altuabatbee janggi tangna man* a ine nikaha, ua a’kawerangko an-tangtangni song dakaha. 3. INDIANI MANDERANG CHENGONI MANDERANG I . Indian! kattara chengo, darang ba gipinchini re*bana skang bilsi hajalni hajal skang uno song- donggipa manderangoni a'bachenga. Chengo India a'songa burungarigipa bang'a matburungrangni aro dal'dalgipa chipurangni dongramsa ong'achim. Song nokrang, ramarang ba songjinmarang gri- chim. Banoba banoba manderang gnang, indiba matburungrang gita rong-kolrango bolgoprango donge biterangko aro ja'dilrangko am'e cha'e

tangachim, aro burungjoljol nagande re-roroachim. Ruutbea chasongrangni ja’mano uamang u'iroroe 5 bodni wa’ni jamdaprangko dakaha. Gkina china- nina bol bigilrangko aro bikaprangko tarie sim'pakrangko doke jakkalaha, matgilrangko ganaha. Matgipa rong'pleng aro rong'petcho- krangko jakkale matchokrangko aro gipin matburungrangko so’otachim. Waddu ra*e rong'tot tote wa'alrangko bikote uamang'ni so'ot- gimin matburungrangko so’e ange cha*na u'iaha. lamang'ken RO'ONGNI CHASONG ine minga. Ua chasongni jakkala rong'plengrangko da'oba an’ching gisep gisep bolrangni dal'pripgiminko ba a* a ning*rangoniko nikna man* a. Anxhingoni mitam manderang uarangkon ui’gijasa goera rong. pra ba goera goani ro’ong ine minga. Ruutbea chasongrangni ja'mano ia manderang nambata cha'anirangko cha'e be’enni bilrangba batbaroroaha aro pilak kamrangon u'ibatroroe changbatbaaha. Uamang a'ani me’dik sam'dik- rangko dakna aro silrangko bikote uarangoniko silchidarerangko dake jakkalna changbaaha aro bolni wa'ni nokrangko rike dongaha. lamang'kon SILNI CHASONG ine chanachim.

Chengonin uamang'o jilanirang gnang aro burungrangko o‘e game sue cha*achim. Uamang'ni songrang, gittimrang are songjinmarangba gnang- chim. Songko nokko dilgipa nokmarangba gnang- chim. Uamang'ni pagitchamrang a'ako, chipuko aro bolrangko mite ine olakkiachim aro uarangna kenachim. Gipin a’songni badinggiparangna mi, segun bol- rang, do’de biparang, mongma wagam, chondon to, mosina ba’ra aro indakgipa bang*a bosturangko palataha ine mesokanirang gnang. Indiba India Mussalman- rangna bate Hindurang namen bang'baibea aro Congressni tik ka*ani gita Democratic Govern-

mento mande bang'ani gitasa pilak bilrang ong'- achim ; nni gimin sasonni pilak kamrango Mussal- manrangna bate Hindurangni bil bang’batachim.
